description: Tracks recent inventory changes — items acquired, used, equipped, or identified. This is a recent-activity log, not a complete inventory list. The character sheet holds the full inventory.

fields.recently_acquired: array of objects — items picked up or received this session: { name, description, quantity }
fields.recently_used: array of objects — items consumed or used: { name, effect_applied, quantity_used }
fields.pending_identifications: array of strings — unidentified items the player is carrying (e.g. 'mysterious vial', 'ornate ring')
fields.equipped_changes: array of strings — equipment changes made (e.g. 'equipped leather armor', 'switched to longsword', 'unequipped shield')
fields.notable_consumables_remaining: array of objects — consumable items worth tracking: { name, quantity_remaining }

notes: This context tracks activity, not the full inventory. Do not attempt to list every item the player owns.
Populate recently_acquired when the outcome describes the player receiving items.
Populate recently_used when the outcome describes the player consuming a potion, scroll, or similar item.
Clear recently_acquired and recently_used periodically when they become stale (several turns with no inventory activity).
